descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-94513 AC 11 · “A pre-round summary started on desktop should be visible/continuable on the phone without re-entering anything”.

Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S11 Pre-round text typed on the computer but not yet saved with Save Note

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 A pre-round note dictated and saved on the computer appears on the phone in real time, with no refresh, and can be continued on the phone without re-entering anything. (UAT TC-25 step 3; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 11; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U6 Steps 2-5 (add, pre-round save, generate, delete) work the same in Nursing Home as in Hospital. (UAT TC-25 step 6; UAT TC-25; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Both devices signed in; {hospitalPatient}

When Computer opens the notes editor, types pre-round text and does not tap Save Note or close the editor; 3 s later (past the 800 ms autosave) the phone opens the chart, appends a line and waits 3 s; the computer keeps the editor open. Run in both modes

Then The phone shows the computer's unsaved-but-typed text and can continue it without re-entering anything; the computer then shows both lines without a refresh

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: cp1 (phone) mustContain 'QA-SYNC-PR-2' (it starts the 60-character notepad preview); cp2 (computer, editor open the whole time, no reload) mustContain 'QA-SYNC-PR-2' and 'QA-SYNC-PR-3', read from the editor's textbox, which holds the full text (the closed row shows only the first 60 characters, PreRoundNotesCard.tsx:236, and 'QA-SYNC-PR-3' starts at character 51). …

Where it ran: dev; test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
